title: Basic English — Course 2, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 5

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When will the portfolio session take place?
tasks.audioText: The careers adviser is introducing a digital skills portfolio on Wednesday at eleven in the media room. Students can add examples of college projects, certificates and practical activities. Each file should include a short description of the student's role. The adviser will demonstrate how to share the portfolio safely with an employer. Bring one example of your completed work.

The careers adviser is introducing a digital skills portfolio on Wednesday at eleven in the media room. Students can add examples of college projects, certificates and practical activities. Each file should include a short description of the student's role. The adviser will demonstrate how to share the portfolio safely with an employer. Bring one example of your completed work.

tasks.prompt: After completing a college project, Denis created a skills portfolio. He included a photograph of the finished model, a short description of the steps he had completed and feedback from his tutor. He did not upload personal information about other students. Before sending the link to an employer, he checked that the files opened correctly and that the sharing settings were limited to people who needed access. Reading 1. What did Denis include in his portfolio?
options: A project photograph, description and tutor feedback

tasks.prompt: Why did Denis check the sharing settings?
options: To limit access to people who needed the files

tasks.prompt: Choose the correct form: 'I have ___ my portfolio before the application deadline.'
Choose TWO useful items for a skills portfolio.
options: A short description of your contribution

tasks.prompt: A collection of examples that demonstrates your abilities is a ___.
You are sending a portfolio link to an employer. What is an appropriate message?
options: Open this now. I will not explain anything.
Please find the link to my portfolio. It includes examples of my college work.
Here is somebody else's private folder.
The link may not work, but I did not check it.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of preparing a skills portfolio in a sensible order.
options: Write a short description of each example
Test the link before sending it
correctOrder: Write a short description of each example
Test the link before sending it

tasks.prompt: Write 60–80 words introducing a skills portfolio to a potential employer. Mention two examples of your work and explain what they demonstrate.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: task completion and relevant content (0–2); clear organisation and sequence (0–2); understandable grammar and sentence structure (0–2); appropriate vocabulary, spelling and punctuation (0–2). Minor errors are acceptable if meaning remains clear.
